content:
[Intro]
[Dm]"In this there is no
teacher, no pupil;
there is no leader;
there is
no guru; there is no
Master, no Saviour You your-
self are the teacher and the pupil;
you are the Master; you are the guru;
you are the leader; you
are everything.
And
to
understand
is to transform what is.
You have to
be a light to yourself,
Not
the light of a profes-
sor, or an analyst, or
a psychologist,
or the light of Jesus,
or the light of the Buddha. You have
to be a light to yourself
in
a world that is utterly be-
coming dark. I

[Verse]
[Bbmaj7]know that what's in
front of me Is a ref-
[Asus4]lection of what is in-
side of me And I
[Dm]see I need to
be myself
[F6]Cause it's so lonely in the
eyes of someone else
[Bbmaj7]And I feel,
oh how I feel
[Asus4]Yeah I feel and I
always will I
[Dm]starve to live
free from fear
[F6]To free myself before I
disappear I
[Bbmaj7]am forever more than
just surviving
[Asus4]This is my life and this
life is my diamond

[Outro]
[Dm]
My time, your
time, our time is running out
My time, your
time, our time is running out
My time, your
time, our time is running out
My time, your
time, our time is running out
title: Diamond
tuning: D G C F A D
